parameters.content:
02_AI_QUESTION_PAPER_ENGINE

The AI brain. Triggered via Execute Workflow from 01_EXAM_CONTROLLER with { examConfig }. Builds a blueprint, generates Set A (and Set B when numberOfSets = 2), checks for duplicate/similar questions between and within sets, regenerates flagged questions once, then returns the final structured question-paper JSON.

SETUP: configure the AI provider credential on the 3 'AI ...' HTTP Request nodes (Set A / Set B / Regenerate). No key is hardcoded.
